# Check if there is any competition where position is 3rd or higher (i.e., position value indicates 1st, 2nd, or 3rd)
# Position column contains strings like "10th", "5th", "3rd", etc. We need to extract the numeric part and compare.
# We'll extract the numeric prefix from the position string and convert to integer.
df['position_numeric'] = df['position'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(int)

# Check if any row has position_numeric <= 3 (since 1st, 2nd, 3rd are 3 or higher in the sense of being top 3)
has_third_or_higher = (df['position_numeric'] <= 3).any()

# The question says "placed third place or higher in one competition", which is true if there is at least one such row.
answer = bool(has_third_or_higher)
